module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Sub-Minimum Lot Remainder Suppression
precondition: Micro-remainder of 0.005 lots when broker enforces strict 0.01 lot step.
expected_result: System strictly rounds to nearest valid 0.01 increment; never submits invalid order sizes to broker API.
actual_result: Sizing engine strictly suppresses sub-0.01 residuals to prevent submitting illegal ticket sizes to liquidity bridges.
